author: Claude
candidate_edge: One opening-range signal per weekday per symbol on EURUSD and GBPUSD anchored to 08:00 Europe/London (mapped deterministically to server time via America/New_York + 7 h): range = the four closed M15 bars before the anchor; first M15 bar in [anchor, anchor+4h) trading outside the range decides: close beyond => breakout arm B, wick-only => failure arm F against the wick; entry at the next bar open, stop = range width W, frozen target arms A15 = 1.5 W / A20 = 2.0 W, thin-range floor / wide-range cap 0.86-1.93 x ATR(14,H1) EURUSD and 0.88-2.06 GBPUSD, flat at 16:00 Europe/London. PRESCREEN OUTCOME: FALSIFIED on the selection period (E[R] -0.054 / -0.068 R, PF 0.91 / 0.89) with commission alone costing a median 0.040 / 0.031 R per trade; RETIRE recommended.
confidence: High that the mechanism as frozen has no net expectancy on 2018-2022 .DWX history (n=932 / 935 per symbol, both arms, both variants negative or flat). Moderate on the absolute level because the simulation is closed-bar M1 with conservative same-bar stop-first resolution, no news filter and zero spread; each of these biases the result in a different direction but none plausibly by +0.10R. The 2023-25 positive cells are regime-dependent (single-year driven) and are not a selection basis.
confounders: Zero spread in .DWX history: the London open is where FX spread widens; the true cost is higher than the commission-only figure (GAP, no figure invented).
News blackout not modelled: the framework filter removes some of the 08:00-12:00 London fires; it lowers density and may change expectancy in either direction.
Conservative same-bar resolution (stop before target) on M1 bars slightly understates winners on volatile bars; the opposite bias (no slippage) overstates them.
Floor/cap thresholds were derived on the selection period; the validation period applies them unchanged (no re-selection).
EURUSD/GBPUSD daily P/L dependence not evaluated (moot after falsification); required before any two-symbol carding.
observations: Prescreen 2018-07-02..2025-12-31 (1,929 / 1,930 trading days). EURUSD: 1,558 trades (818 B, 740 F); SEL A15 B+F n=932, 0.79/bd, E[R] -0.054, PF 0.91, worst-year DD 36.5R; VAL n=626, +0.022, PF 1.04 (breakout-only VAL +0.169 / PF 1.33 after -0.109 in SEL = regime flip, 2024 alone +55.6R). GBPUSD: 1,524 trades; SEL A15 B+F n=935, 0.80/bd, -0.068, PF 0.89, DD 50.0R; VAL n=589, +0.058, PF 1.11. A20 arms are worse than A15 in SEL on both symbols. Commission median 0.040R (EURUSD) / 0.031R (GBPUSD) per trade; spread unmeasured for FX majors (GAP). Frozen-screen baselines unchanged: 13213 0.74/bd +0.064R; 41484 transplant EURUSD -0.082R, GBPUSD -0.015R.
proposed_mechanism: London-session opening-range breakout/failure as the native-session counterpart of the Balke Tokyo-range mechanism (13213) for EURUSD/GBPUSD, after the verbatim transplant of the Tokyo window failed (41484 fan-out). Revision 2 measured the mechanism directly: density 0.75-0.80 trades/bd per symbol is present, expectancy is not (the 60-minute pre-open range is too thin, median 14.5 / 22.1 pips, for the range-width stop to carry the registry commission, before any spread).
